headline: 阿米哈默回歸及中古藝術導覽
context: 演員 Armie Hammer 在 Uwe Boll 執導的低成本電影《Citizen Vigilante》中重出江湖，評論形容這對他的形象而言是又一次跌落。另一則報導則在拜約掛毯（Bayeux Tapestry）票價 33 英鎊的背景下，推薦幾個免費觀賞中世紀藝術的替代選項。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Want to see some old wonders but don’t fancy forking out £33 for 40 minutes with a tapestry? Our critic celebrates the British treasures you can see all year round – from monstrous crypt carvings to the vaulting glory of our cathedrals There’s a carved stone character grimacing furiously in the crypt of Canterbury Cathedral and you can see why – a man is sitting on his head, legs apart, holding a fish and bowl in outstretched arms. Other figures perched atop slender stone columns include a creature with a serpent’s tail wrestling a dog-like monstrosity, a gryphon eating a siren, and a (now-detached) carving of a horned devil. All this nefariousness in the depths of England’s holiest shrine. But then medieval British art is full of wonder, mystery and humour. It is also so abundant that it gets taken for granted. But now, after almost 1,000 years, it is about to have a moment. This week, the rush will begin to get £33 tickets to spend 40 minutes in the company of a medieval British artwork. The Bayeux Tapestry, a 70-metre embroidery depicting the Norman conquest of England in 1066, was almost certainly embroidered by Kent women to a commission by Bishop Odo of Bayeux in the 1070s. sources.title: Never mind the Bayeux! Here’s some other great medieval art – and it’s free

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Low-budget film-maker Uwe Boll sets Hammer up for a further fall from grace by cannibalising all manner of tired tropes in this incoherent schlocker Oh, Armie Hammer! Has it come to this? It doesn’t seem that long since you were in the Oscar-winning film Call Me By Your Name giving a sensitive liberal performance opposite Timothée Chalamet. Now here you are, striding around the streets and public parks of Zagreb, shooting Muslims, tasering teens and topping complicit deep-state judges to protest against what your character robustly describes as an “unfriendly takeover by Islamist extremists and the blind-sided woke left”. Much has happened to this once garlanded actor and great-grandson of oil tycoon Armand Hammer. His reputation plummeted after allegations of sexual assault by former partners in 2021 , relationships that Hammer has maintained were consensual. Criminal charges were since dropped for lack of evidence, Hammer has now returned to the silver screen – and here he is in a very cheap, incoherent and embarrassingly badly acted schlocker, written, produced and directed by Germany’s low-budget exploitation maestro Uwe Boll, which cannibalises all manner of revenge tropes. More importantly, the film has been promoted and publicised globally online with monumental hypocrisy by Elon Musk who like JD Vance is very keen to divert America’s attention from its own issues to the fiercely imagined lawless migrant-caliphate of Europe-stan. It’s another piece of shit to flood the zone. Continue reading...
sources.title: Citizen Vigilante review – Armie Hammer returns to obliterate the imaginary woke piñata of Europe-stan

thread_text:
Armie Hammer 低成本新片復出，另有中世紀免費藝術推薦

Armie Hammer 在 Uwe Boll 執導的低成本電影《Citizen Vigilante》中重出江湖。評論認為這部片充斥老套敘事，讓 Hammer 的復出成了又一次跌落。

另一方面，英國的拜約掛毯（Bayeux Tapestry）入場費高達 33 英鎊，只有 40 分鐘參觀時間。一位評論家因此整理了幾個免費欣賞中世紀藝術的方案——大教堂與各地博物館的典藏，都是不必掏腰包的選項。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
Armie Hammer 低成本新片復出，另有中世紀免費藝術推薦

Armie Hammer 在 Uwe Boll 執導的低成本電影《Citizen Vigilante》中重出江湖。評論認為這部片走的是消費「打擊想像中的左派好萊塢」的路線，充斥老套橋段，讓 Hammer 的復出再跌一跤。

英國的拜約掛毯入場費 33 英鎊，只有 40 分鐘參觀時間，引起一些討論。一位評論家整理了幾個免費觀賞中世紀藝術的替代方案，包括各地大教堂和博物館的典藏。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
Armie Hammer 在低成本新片中復出。導演是 Uwe Boll，片名《Citizen Vigilante》，評論認為這部片走的是老套敘事路線，讓 Hammer 的復出對形象而言是又一次跌落。

另一邊，英國的拜約掛毯（Bayeux Tapestry）入場費 33 英鎊，只有 40 分鐘。有評論家整理了幾個免費欣賞中世紀藝術的替代選項，像是各地大教堂和博物館的典藏。
